decisions.reason: The height-adjustable executive desk builds on the firm's strong office business and serves the growing demand for flexible workplaces, so keeping it costs little and its value is still unfolding.
The chair family sits close to the core offer and fits the long catalog life typical of premium German furniture, and it was showcased on its own page through 2019 with no sign of failure.
The carpet floor cushions are a niche accessory with uncertain demand, but they reuse the rug materials cheaply and add to the curated materials offer, so the option is worth keeping open.
The designer sofa by EOOS was actively promoted in 2019 and sits in the core upholstery business, so its likely value justifies further commitment.
The high standing table suits adaptable conference and lounge settings close to the core offer, and keeping it in the range is cheap.

The rug collection is distant from the core, but it extends the interior-solutions strategy and was still presented in 2019, and with no evidence that its value won't be realized, the option stays open.
